about.title: About
body: Full-stack developer with a Bachelor of Economics in Financial Management. I designed and built, as the sole developer, a production ordering and operations platform for an international food and beverage client.
I care about clean architecture, accessibility and security, and I am certified by Google, IBM, Microsoft and Amazon in full-stack development and data analytics.

bullets: Designed and built, as the sole developer, a production ordering and operations platform: customer storefront, B2B partner portal, admin console and REST API, spanning 45+ pages (React, TypeScript, NestJS, Prisma, PostgreSQL).
Integrated online payments through a third-party gateway with automated reconciliation, and built a configurable pricing engine for tax, fees, promotions and delivery.
Launched a B2B ordering channel with role-based access and separate retail and wholesale pricing, replacing manual ordering.
Delivered real-time order tracking, live chat, back-office automation and automatic receipt printing through Android and Windows print agents.
Applied secure development practices (authentication and authorization, input protection, automated security scanning) and shipped CI/CD with Docker, GitHub Actions and about 95 automated test files.
